content: 5:1-20 Begent qib igorun
Qenu sig-sig mom anmusuor end an wonou wau iitari igoarar.

Munon inubersiau tari at qib inimbigor gas ende at qi qenungau qomon end qas qib igoarar. Wo ende at ne umb wogub inmusuor eng mian yamari qogom sig uber iroa Qenut igub mismisiroau gas ende ebeterei.
An Qenu wonou munon yurau qau. End an bo maigas yamangar song-song nob qib qiyo, qarig ir qiyo, a qomon boru oau naget qiyo, a mi eng gagar an bo wobon end bais me abar.
Qob isi ne qob soagen ne qob boru gag-gag gor me qamarar. Qomon eng Qenu magqurt misue ar. End an Qenut qenen mismisir uber qamb igoarar.

An mom ete musub imbigar, munon yamangar song-song wurinob qib qiyo, a misir soagen igub qiyo, a oau naget igo eng, wo aibigau song-song eng toat igo ebet igo. Munon yurau eng wuri Qenu ne Munon inubersiau tari wurinou bibis end me igorunorei.
Munon qei abari anmurimar qob soagen me aninob qomorunor. Ende obounor eng Qenu wonou qob omboariramau gas eng gab wo misiringeteriba.
End ne an munon boru qomon eng nob igour eng an bo me wuri magermar.
Qoan aninou itum end igumanei. Ego see an Munon Aib wonou yurau anqubei ne anamar yar begen end anwagerei. End an begent qib igoun gas ende at qib igoarar.
Begent qib igamau mi git eng, qomon uber ne qomon qoregen ne qob apand qas qamarau eng.
Munon Aib wonou qomon uber end qib igoarar qamb animbigar end wariges qib igamari Qenu animbag anitreminer.
Munon qomon boru ebet igour eng me wuri magermar. Qomon eng itum gas ende. An qomon qoregen end qib igamari qomon boru eng dibenteriner.
(Wuri qomon boru waber qi ebet igour eng ye dibes me qemerinei qabari qubig wogoum).
Ego meimi qomon ger munon ebet igour eng begen eng wot begenara diban gab ne uber boru nob qereimboun.
Qenu wonou begen eng gari mi gugum begesia begent uburiba. Qob eng igo end ne munon yurau end wurit ete qura:

content.text: An munon inab igoumon eng an umau mumun gas ende. End qand der bugab qob igar. Igari Munon inubersiau tari anqubeima ne wonou begen eng anit begeneriner.

content: An qoyamet qib igoarar. Munon misir ue qib igamau gas ende at me qib igoarar. Munon qoyam imbi-imbi misir qoregen igub qib igamau gas ende at qib igoarar.
Qen see igoun eng qen borut igoun. End Qenu wonou qomon ne wonou misir eng toat igamau eng. Ar igumune qen eng isi isiner qamb.
An me qangangetarar, Munon Aib wonou qomon abar qamb qenunget igo eng qoot abar.
Wain ya eng aib nub me qangangetarar. Qomon eng an ba sumungasi igo. Wagari Qenu Igomurur eng anmuaserama ten igoarar.
Ende aba an qiumuni munon qei wurinob qamb gab eng buk Sam qob eng qiyo, uru wab qiyo, ende at ne Munon Aib wot oau uber burab uru wab igoarar.
Ininou Munon Aib Yisas Munon inubersiau tari wo gab-gab Qenu ininou Tain mi gugum indab igo end uberet unum bemeni igoarar.
5:21-33 Munon yamangar qibaub musub igorunor
An Yisas ininou Munon aib unum bemeni ne an gari gari der Qenu wonou yurau wuri ii igoarar.
Yamangar an, Munon Aib qob qamara igetet igoumon gas ende aninou munon gor igatar igoarar.

Aninou munon eng wuri aninou baraitari igo anoar igour. Munon inubersiau tari sios munon yurau qeretutnob oroar igo gas ende. Ne Sios yurau eng Munon inubersiau tari wonou musuor end Sios eng Munon inubersiau tari wonou git goan.
End Sios wonou Munon inubersiau tari igama ii igo gas ende an yamangar aninou munon wuri ii igoarar.
An munon, aninou yamangar wuriqenungarar. Munon inubersi igo eng Sios qenunget ne wonomi dui umb Sios musuor gas ende.
Wo ende at ne Sios ya qob nob ba Sios birogonimau gas ende aba oan bura ne Sios eng wonosiarei.
Ende ebet Sios git goan eng gar eng sig maieng, unun ger ue, ninir ger ue, maieng ar. Sios mindigar qob ue, qau igoar qamb.
Eng gas ende an munon aninou yamangar wuritoubar wuriqenungarar. Aninou git goant igub igoumon gas ende abar. Munon wonou ubenit igub musub igo eng wonou git goan musub igo gas ende.
In gugum at imbig igoum eng, munon ger wonou git goan siningot me nob yogub igo. Wo mi uta nia musub qoat igo. Eng gas ende gari Munon inubersi igo eng Sios ende at musub igo.
End in Yisast unum iramin end wonou git goan igeragart eng in sios igoun.
End ne Qenu qob ete igo: munon ger yamangar baub eng ur unor mom wuriwogub wes opur isub ombur bo git goan gari qas burab igour.
Qob eng qanam aib waber igo end munon maigas me imbigunerei. Ego yonou misir igoum eng Yisas Sios wonou sieriner end qamarei.
Ne qob eng anit gor qamarei igo. An munon gari-gari, aninou git goant igub musub igoumon gas ende aninou yamangar wurimusiarar. Ne yamangar, an aninou munon im ibag igoarar.
